title: Measuring the Change Amount of a Design Studio Selections Change Order
content:
**Measurement rule.** The change amount of a change order on a Design Studio Selections file is measured by the shape of the change order:

1. where it removes exactly one option line and adds exactly one option line of the same category, the change amount is the added line's price less the price at which the removed line had been selected;
2. where it only removes option lines, the change amount is the removal credits booked under it;
3. any other change order is measured as the price of the option lines it adds less the removal credits booked under it, never below zero.

**Terms.** Lines added and removed "under" a change order are the option line and removal entries carrying its change order number. *Removal credits booked under it* are the credits on those removal entries. *The price at which the removed line had been selected* is the price on that line's original selection entry. Categories are those shown on the entries (structural, electrical, plumbing, cabinetry, countertops, flooring, appliances, exterior).

**Hypothetical cases**

| Change order shape | Figures | Change amount |
|---|---|---|
| Removes one cabinetry line (selected at 3000.00, removal credit 1500.00); adds one cabinetry line at 4200.00 | 4200.00 less 3000.00 | 1200.00 |
| Removes one flooring line (removal credit 800.00); adds nothing | Removal credits | 800.00 |
| Removes one flooring line (removal credit 800.00); adds one cabinetry line at 2000.00 | 2000.00 less 800.00 | 1200.00 |
| Adds two lines totalling 2500.00; removes nothing | 2500.00 less 0.00 | 2500.00 |
| Removes two lines (credits 900.00); adds one line at 600.00 | 600.00 less 900.00, never below zero | 0.00 |
